title: Ride application-guide template with a fictional worked example
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Each ride needs its own application guide: ride class, approved anchors or wrap members, required modules, tether-angle check and exclusions (e.g., capsizable water rides, H27). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Create a fill-in template plus one fully worked FICTIONAL example (a generic non-inverting coaster seat), clearly labelled fictional.
acceptanceCriteria: Template fields cover every requirement checked per ride
Worked example is fictional and names no real ride or manufacturer
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
